sentences.en: Look at the cute little baby sleeping in the cradle.
sentences.zh: 1. 看看睡在摇篮里的那个可爱的小宝宝。

sentences.en: Hope is a staff, from the cradle to the grave.
sentences.zh: 2. 希望是拐杖，从摇篮到坟墓。

sentences.en: The hand that rocks the cradle rules the world.
sentences.zh: 3. 摇动摇篮的手统治着世界。

senses.zh: 摇篮；发源地；发祥地；支船架
抚育；把...搁在支架上；把...放在摇篮内
